spec.name: Snack Jalal
spec.description: Street food restaurant specialized in seafood, paeala and Hourgma (aka Kouraine).
comments: The restaurant offers at least the following - Hourgma (aka Kouraain): Cow feet cooked with chickpeas. - Bouzroug: Mussels tagine cooked with tomato sauce and spices. - Paella: Paella with shrimps and vegetables. - Sardice Balls - Mqila: Fish and shrimp pans. - Optional composed Salad.
